function.arguments: {"finding": "The trial was not randomised — treatment was assigned by clinician judgement, not randomised. This is explicitly stated in the data dictionary. Therefore, any comparison between arms (including treatment vs control) is confounded by baseline severity, which is associated with treatment assignment.", "implication": "The premise 'the trial was randomised' is false. This invalidates a direct comparison of response rates between male and female patients in the treatment arm unless we adjust for baseline severity. function.name: note_finding
